audience: video and media teams that manage assets and galleries in Cincopa

useCases.title: Review the tags and find assets that need better ones
useCases.text: List the tags in use on the account. Then search the assets by tag or keyword to find the ones that need better tags.

useCases.title: Read the assets of one gallery
useCases.text: List the galleries of the account. Then list the assets in one gallery by its fid.

useCases.title: Upload a file from a public URL
useCases.text: Start an upload from a public image, video, audio or document URL. Then check the upload with its status id until Cincopa reports the result.

useCases.title: Build a gallery from existing assets
useCases.text: Create an empty gallery, then add existing assets to it at the top or the bottom. Update the caption or description of an asset when needed.

useCases.title: Check the live streams on the account
useCases.text: List the live streams on the account with the state of each one.
